limits: Shared host, sequential observations rather than a randomized speedup estimate; package proof and isolated diagnostic builds overlapped some focused measurements.

The full changed-package run preceded the final shared-cap, independent descriptor-readback prepare/cleanup-error and nested teardown refinements; restored focused/control runs and the wide replay bind their final behavior.
JUnit file times, summed case body times, invocation builds and command wall times are distinct measurements.
Output-only report paths are kept private. No local timing value updates the qualified hosted cost table.
Long wall-time outage endurance is not inferred from logical backoff progression; the original explicit native horizons and all behavior oracles remain.
